text: **The check is demonstrated RED in both directions before any green is trusted.** Delete a row from a table and watch the right entity fail; add a row for a property that does not exist and watch the other direction fail. **A check whose positive case has never been observed is not evidence**, and both arms are needed because a one-sided demonstration leaves the untested direction free to be a constant pass.
